library(viridis)
library(ggstream)

D19<-read_xlsx("OSRI_Totals_Full.xlsx")

D19<-D19%>%#Reorder layman group to be more intuitive
  mutate(Layman_group = factor(Layman_group, levels = c("Seaweed","Snails","Urchins/ Starfish","Octopus","Clams", "Mussels","Crabs/ Shrimp","Fish","Seals/ Whales")))
##Figure 1 - Data in Analysis- Ridge plot chart or area density chart with Time on x-axis and samples reported on y, colors are studies, hues are databases? Too much?
#####

all_years <- unique(D19$Year_clean)
all_studies <- unique(D19$Study_name_cleaner)
complete_grid <- expand.grid(Year_clean = all_years, Study_name_cleaner = all_studies)

summary_df <- D19 %>%
  group_by(Year_clean, Study_name_cleaner) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop")

summary_df_complete <- complete_grid %>%
  left_join(summary_df, by = c("Year_clean", "Study_name_cleaner")) %>%
  mutate(Count = replace_na(Count, 0)) %>%
  arrange(Year_clean, Study_name_cleaner)

summary_cumulative <- summary_df_complete %>%
  group_by(Study_name_cleaner) %>%
  arrange(Year_clean) %>%
  mutate(CumulativeCount = cumsum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(
    Year_clean=as.numeric(Year_clean)
  )

# Plot
ggplot(summary_cumulative, aes(x = Year_clean, y = Count, group = Study_name_cleaner, fill= Study_name_cleaner)) +
  geom_stream(color = "white", size = 0.1, alpha = 0.9,type = "ridge", bw=1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Study",option = "D") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x= "",
    y = "Number of Observations") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = c(1.025, 1.10),  # Position legend inside plot (x, y from bottom-left)
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),  # Anchor the legend box
    legend.background = element_blank(),   # transparent background
    legend.box.background = element_blank(),  # remove outer box
    legend.key = element_blank(),           # transparent boxes behind keys
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave(filename = "Figures/Fig1-ObservationsByStudyOverTime.png",    # output file name
  plot = last_plot(),                   # or specify your plot object like `my_plot`
  device = "png",
  width = 8.5,                          # half of standard 11-inch paper width
  height = 5.5,                         # full height of standard paper
  units = "in",
  dpi=300)

##Figure 2a - Pie chart of taxa and observations with list of species under each label
STILL CANT GET LABEL POSITION RIGHT
#####
library(ggrepel)

taxa_summary <- D19 %>%
  group_by(Layman_group, Common_name) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Layman_group) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalCount = sum(Count),
    SpeciesList = paste(unique(Common_name), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalCount)) %>%
  mutate(
    Fraction = TotalCount / sum(TotalCount),
    ymax = cumsum(Fraction),
    ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0),
    label_pos = (ymax + ymin)/5,
    Label = paste0(Layman_group, "\n(n=", TotalCount, ")")
  )

# Step 2: Create Plot
ggplot(taxa_summary, aes(x = "", y = TotalCount, fill = Layman_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack",width = 10) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y", direction = 1) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Taxonomic Group") +

  # Internal pie labels
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_pos, y = label_pos, label = Label),
    color = "white",
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) #+

  # External species annotations
  geom_label_repel(
    aes(x = 1.8, y = label_pos, label = SpeciesList, fill = Layman_group),
    size = 2.8,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    segment.size = 0.4,
    segment.color = "gray60",
    label.size = 0.2,
    force = 1.5,
    nudge_x = 0.5,
    direction = "y",
    max.overlaps = 200,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Make sure labels fit
  #xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(filename = "Figures/Fig2a-SpeciesObservationsBreakdown.png",    # output file name
  plot = last_plot(),                   # or specify your plot object like `my_plot`
  device = "png",
  width = 8.5,                          # half of standard 11-inch paper width
  height = 5.5,                         # full height of standard paper
  units = "in",
  dpi=300)

#Figure 3 - Boxplots of Taxa and all observations Total PAHs

ggplot(data=D19, aes(x = `Layman_group`, y = log(`Total_PAH`), color = `Layman_group`)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +  # Removes the outlier markers from the boxplot
  geom_jitter(aes(color = `Layman_group`), 
              width = 0.2, height = 0, size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +  # Add jittered points
  labs(title = "Log PAH concentrations measured in marine organisms", x = "", y = "log(Total PAHs (ng/g))") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",  # Removes the legend
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)  # Rotate x-axis text
  )

  plot = last_plot(),                   # or specify your plot object like `my_plot`

  width = 8.5,                          #

#Figure 4 - Panel break down of Results in Fish, inverts, and marine mammal by species_standard
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
##Fish
#####
custom_order <- c("salmon", "anadromous/freshwater fish", "forage fish", "flatfish", "cod", "other fish")

D19_fish <- D19 %>%
  filter(Layman_group == "Fish") %>%
  mutate(
    logPAH = log(Total_PAH),
    Species_standard = factor(Species_standard, levels = custom_order)  # Custom facet order
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species_standard, Common_name) %>%
  mutate(Common_name = fct_reorder(Common_name, logPAH, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()


ggplot(D19_fish, aes(x = Common_name, y = logPAH, color = Common_name)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Species_standard, scales = "free_x"
             , nrow = 1, labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 15) ) +
  labs(
    title = "Log PAH concentrations measured in Fish",
    x = "",
    y = "log(Total PAHs (ng/g))"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text( size = 9)
  )
ggsave(filename = "Figures/Fig4a-LogMeasurementsinFish.png",    # output file name
  plot = last_plot(),                   # or specify your plot object like `my_plot`
  device = "png",
  width = 10,                          # half of standard 11-inch paper width
  height = 4.5,                         # full height of standard paper
  units = "in",
  dpi=300)

#Non Log Version

all_years <- unique(D19$Year_clean)
all_taxa <- unique(D19$Layman_group)
complete_grid <- expand.grid(Year_clean = all_years, Layman_group = all_taxa)

summary_df1 <- D19 %>%
  group_by(Year_clean, Layman_group) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop")

summary_df_complete <- complete_grid %>%
  left_join(summary_df1, by = c("Year_clean", "Layman_group")) %>%
  mutate(Count = replace_na(Count, 0)) %>%
  arrange(Year_clean, Layman_group)

summary_cumulative <- summary_df_complete %>%
  group_by(Layman_group) %>%
  arrange(Year_clean) %>%
  mutate(CumulativeCount = cumsum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(
    Year_clean=as.numeric(Year_clean)
  )

# Plot
ggplot(summary_cumulative, aes(x = Year_clean, y = Count, group = Layman_group, fill= Layman_group)) +
  geom_stream(color = "white", size = 0.1, alpha = 0.9,type = "ridge", bw=1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Taxa",option = "D") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x= "",
    y = "Number of Observations") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = c(0.85, 1.10),  # Position legend inside plot (x, y from bottom-left)
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),  # Anchor the legend box
    legend.background = element_blank(),   # transparent background
    legend.box.background = element_blank(),  # remove outer box
    legend.key = element_blank(),           # transparent boxes behind keys
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
